title: Optimal scenario design for climate emulation
abstract: arXiv:2606.19302v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As deep learning for physical systems continues to grow in popularity, efforts to improve generalizability have primarily focused on designing architectures that embed physical constraints. However, for machine-learning surrogate climate models (emulators), we show that the low structural diversity in existing scenarios commonly used to generate training data places a ceiling on predictive skill. Here, we examine whether training datasets themselves can be optimized to improve generalization. We introduce a method to create datasets that produce emulators capable of generalizing to new, structurally different scenarios absent from the training data. We use a differentiable Simple Climate Model (SCM) to calculate the sensitivity of emulator loss to perturbations in the training data, iteratively updating the training data to maximize emulator skill. translated_title: 面向气候模拟器的最优情景设计
translated_abstract: 随着针对物理系统的深度学习日益流行，提升泛化能力的努力主要集中在设计嵌入物理约束的神经网络架构上。然而，对于机器学习替代气候模型（即气候仿真器），我们表明，现有常用于生成训练数据的情景中较低的结构多样性为预测技能设置了上限。本文研究了训练数据集本身是否可以被优化以改善泛化能力。我们提出了一种创建数据集的方法，用其训练出的仿真器能够泛化到训练数据中不存在的、结构上不同的新情景。我们利用一个可微分的简单气候模型（SCM）来计算仿真器损失对训练数据扰动的敏感性，并迭代更新训练数据以最大化仿真器性能。对于一个简单气候模型，在这种方式下优化出的单一情景上进行训练，其效果优于……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种利用可微分简单气候模型迭代优化训练情景数据集的方法，使气候仿真器能够泛化到训练数据中不存在的、结构上不同的新情景，突破了现有训练数据结构多样性不足带来的性能上限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a method that uses a differentiable Simple Climate Model to iteratively optimize training scenarios, enabling climate emulators to generalize to structurally different scenarios absent from the training data and overcoming the performance ceiling imposed by low structural diversity in existing scenarios.
